plugins.name: tilnote-blog
plugins.description: Write blog posts together with AI and publish them to your Tilnote blog. Look a topic up and write it in your own words, upgrade posts you already have, turn a post into Threads, X, LinkedIn and KakaoTalk versions, get a researched news briefing on the topics you follow, make a book you want to read - table of contents first, each chapter written when you open it - see what to write next, and keep your writing style in one note. Drafts stay private until you say publish.
